job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois State Retirement Systems RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its lead-actuary requirements do not state the required 15 years of public-system experience or 3 years with comparable California pension clients.
quotes: The State Retirement Systems (“SRS” or “Systems”) are requesting proposals for actuarial consulting services and actuarial advice for the Boards of Trustees and SRS staff.
The lead actuary must meet the American Academy of Actuaries Qualification Standards for an Enrolled Pension Actuary for the duration of the contract.
